profile.name: Naïve
profile.description: naïve (usenaive.ai) is an AI‑first platform that lets you create and run fully autonomous companies using multi‑agent teams. By defining agents, their models, tools, budgets, and policies in a single config file, businesses can delegate tasks across specialized agents—CEO, clipper, producer, and sub‑agents—to handle content creation, social posting, e‑commerce, ads, recruiting, and more. Integrated with dozens of third‑party services (YouTube, TikTok, Shopify, Stripe, Slack, etc.), each agent operates with its own identity (email, phone, domain) and executes actions under strict governance. Pre‑built templates let you launch ready‑made operations such as short‑form video production, SEO agencies, newsletters, and paid‑ads campaigns, all orchestrated without manual coding. The platform provides unified infrastructure from company formation to payout, enabling rapid deployment of AI‑driven enterprises.

The breakouts that matter are the Polsia videos (hustlewithmax37 at 138x followers, 0.99 saves/like; ai.willv at 243k views on 452 followers, "cheat code for businesses"), plus AI side-hustle clips that run on "Claude" and "sidehustle" tags (zachhh.mp4 at 212x, 0.82 saves/like). Polsia is the closest analogue to Naïve: an autonomous AI-run business pitched to solo operators. The only selling signal is colbyscales ("fill out the form to work with me", 0.79 saves/like, 9k followers), which is a lead-gen CTA for an AI automation service. briefing.summary: One face-to-camera vertical video (30–45 sec) in your usual TikTok voice. You say you're exhausted and want AI agents running your channel in the next 2 years. briefing.hook: I told Naïve, "I'm exhausted. And I want to stop working in the next 2 years. I want AI agents running my channel." Here's the exact template I deployed. (Put the line on screen as text, ending with 👇.)
talking_points: Open with the hook, straight to camera, tired and honest. Don't start with a greeting.
Naïve is a place where you pick a company template, like short-form video or an online store, deploy it, and a team of AI agents runs that business.
You used Naïve Studio in the browser. No terminal.
You clicked Deploy on "Naïve Short Form v1".
Watch the first session run. The agent team briefs, scripts and generates a short vertical video in the channel's own look, then queues it for you.
Several agents work at the same time on the goal.
The part you care about: sensitive actions wait for your yes. You approve anything that costs money, and the chat says "Waiting for your approval".
Say plainly what you saw. If the video was good, say so. If it needs work, say that. Don't promise results or income.
shots: Shot 1, 0–4 sec: face to camera, close, your normal setup. Deliver the hook. Burn the hook text on screen.

Shot 2: screen recording of the Naïve Studio template list (Short Form v1, Long Form v1, Clipping v1, AI Music Channel, AI Influencer). Cursor clicks Deploy on Naïve Short Form v1. Voiceover or cut back to you.
Shot 3: screen recording of the first session running, with several agents working at once. Speed it up if it drags.
Shot 4: the finished short vertical video the team queued. Show a few seconds of it.
Shot 5: screenshot or recording of the Approvals queue or the chat saying "Waiting for your approval" (a Deny button is there). Say what it means in one line.
Shot 6: back to face to camera for a 5–8 sec wrap-up and your usual sign-off.
deliverables: One vertical 9:16 video, 30–45 sec, with captions burned in.
The final file, plus the raw screen recordings if you have them.
We post it on Naïve's own accounts. Ask us first if you also want to post it on yours.
dos: Actually sign up, deploy Naïve Short Form v1 and record the real first session.
Say the hook line as written, or very close to it.
Show the Studio template list and the Deploy click on screen.
Mention the approvals step: you approve anything that costs money.
Keep it honest and a bit tired, in your own voice.
Use only what you saw in the product.
donts: Don't promise income, followers or views.
Don't say the agents run fully unsupervised. Sensitive actions need your approval.
Don't claim TikTok or YouTube will accept automated posting, and don't quote a price. We have no confirmed info on either.
Don't call the video "viral" or "perfect". Describe what you got.
Don't deploy or show templates marked Preview as if they work.
Don't show real passwords, API keys or private inboxes in screen recordings.

briefing.title: Gary the Potato Deploys a Company
briefing.summary: One face-to-camera vertical video, about 25 to 35 seconds, in your own style. You're broke and have no team, so Gary the potato (a real potato with googly eyes, or a potato on your desk) becomes your 'CEO'. You open Naïve Studio in the browser, click Deploy on the Naïve Short Form v1 template, and watch the first session run. The joke is a potato with a company. The product beat is real: pick a template, deploy it, and the agent team does the work.
briefing.hook: On-screen text and spoken in the first second: "POV: you can't afford a team." Hold Gary up to camera, deadpan, and say: "So I hired Gary."
talking_points: Open with the hook. You can't afford a team, so Gary is in charge now.
Gary does not do the work. In Naïve you pick a company template, like Short Form video, and deploy it. A team of AI agents runs the business.
It's in the browser. No terminal. Click Deploy on "Naïve Short Form v1" and watch the first session run.
The agent team briefs, scripts and generates a short vertical video in the channel's own look and queues it for you.
Each agent gets its own email, phone number, domains and accounts, so it acts like a real team member.
Gary still has to approve things. Anything that costs money waits for your yes ("Waiting for your approval"). Gary hits Deny on one.
Close with a one-line payoff in your voice, for example: "Gary deployed a company. You're still doing your own edits." Point to Naïve as the CTA.
shots: 1. (0-3s) Face to camera, vertical, Gary held up close. Hook text on screen. Fast, slightly chaotic energy.

2. (3-8s) Quick cut to you looking at the camera, then a screen recording of the Naïve Studio template list. Click Deploy on "Naïve Short Form v1". Other templates (Long Form, Clipping, AI Music Channel, AI Influencer) can be visible in the list.
3. (8-16s) Screen recording of the first session running with several agents working at once. Voiceover or on-camera reaction cuts over it. Gary can pop in as a reaction cutaway.
4. (16-22s) Screen of an agent's inbox or the Email page (New inbox button) while you say each agent gets its own email and accounts.
5. (22-28s) Screen of the Approvals queue with an action waiting. Cut to Gary, then tap Deny on screen. Use the 'Waiting for your approval' line if it shows in chat.
6. (28-35s) Back to face to camera with Gary. Deliver the closing line and CTA. End on the 'ℕ naïve' name on screen.
deliverables: One vertical 9:16 video, about 25 to 35 seconds, face to camera, posted or handed over for the brand's accounts
Includes the Studio screen recording of the Deploy click and the first session running
Raw clip files on request so the brand can recut
dos: Play it deadpan. The potato is the joke, the product is the real part.
Show the real Studio: the Deploy click on Naïve Short Form v1 and the first session running.
Say plainly that it runs in the browser with no terminal.
Mention that approvals are needed for anything that costs money.
Say the product name as "Naïve".
donts: Don't claim earnings, views, revenue or that the videos will perform well.
Don't say agents run with no supervision. Sensitive actions need your approval.
Don't mention pricing, and don't say every template is deployable (some are Preview only).
Don't promise that TikTok or YouTube will accept automated posting.
Don't invent features beyond the ones in this brief.
briefing.timeline: Send a draft or rough cut within 5 days of getting access to Naïve Studio. One round of small edits, then post within 2 days of approval.
briefing.fee: $150 flat for one video, with usage on the brand's own accounts.
